_comment: Seed fixture for the event-timeline-htmx widget-type bead.
Created for ka-0000000243 (Phase 4 free-htmx port — third port after
activity-log-htmx (MR !2334 / ka-0000004584) and related-tickets-htmx
(MR !2346 / ka-0000005540)). Strategy A — port-then-soak: lives
alongside the Go-coded `event-timeline` slug (widgets_phase7.go) rather
than replacing it. Authoring path:
kd create 'Free-htmx widget: event-timeline-htmx' \
--type=widget-type \
-F gardenio/controller/cmd/beads-viewer/fixtures/event-timeline-htmx.json
Pre-write hooks (kbeads/internal/server/widget_validation.go) parse
template_source under html/template and reject malformed inputs at
createBead/updateBead time, so a bad fixture surfaces immediately.
Schema validation runs against widget-instance writes per the same
pre-write hook; the schema below is the wire contract.
The wire contract mirrors the Go-coded `event-timeline` renderer at
widgets_phase7.go::renderEventTimeline — flat events[] with
when/kind/title/detail/url. Three intentional parity gaps documented
in TestEventTimelineParity and the port doc:
1. uPlot canvas (data-uplot-config) — needs MarshalTimelineConfig
server-side. The htmx body emits the static <ol> fallback only.
2. Lanes header — derived server-side from sorted events. Producers
who want the chip header may pre-compute a lanes[] array; the
template renders it when supplied.
3. Source-kind sanitization — Go path forces unknown kinds to
'code'; htmx template emits kind verbatim. Producers should
pre-sanitize to one of the eight Phase-1 source kinds (mezmo,
victoria-metrics, victoria-traces, sentry, jira, gitlab, code,
slack).
